english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something broad in range or scope, especially research, knowledge, or interests, rather than a large physical area.

examples.english: I have extensive interests in the history of different parts of the world.
examples.traditional: 我對世界各地嘅歷史都有廣泛興趣。
